catalysts.headline: Reported fiscal Q4 and full-year FY2026 results (year ended 2026-06-30): Q4 revenue $137.2M (miss vs ~$139-157M consensus depending on source); AI cloud revenue $70.5M, up from $33.6M QoQ (+110%), now 51.4% of quarterly revenue; bitcoin-mining revenue fell to $66.7M from $111.2M QoQ; Q4 adjusted EBITDA $19.2M (vs ~$34.9M expected); FY2026 revenue $707M (+41.1% YoY from $501M in FY2025); management said the $4B FY2026 ARR target is fully contracted, plus an incremental $700M ARR tied to an NVIDIA cloud agreement starting to ramp in 2027; FY2027 capex guided at $25B-$30B
